fields.Name: T063 - Action Detail Custom Form Parameters and Code Accordions
fields.Description: The custom ActionFormComponentExtended override with bespoke accordion sections (Parameters, Code & Generation, Runtime Config) and an embedded Run harness launcher — a distinct render path from the generic generated entity form.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 35,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "Opening an action record shows a custom form with the action name and Status/Type status chips in the header",
    "A collapsible 'Parameters' accordion is present and, when expanded, shows Input Parameters and Output Parameters sub-sections",
    "For a Generated-type action a 'Code & Generation' section is available (or the section is appropriately absent for non-Generated actions)",
    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
